target.title: policy: preview alsoAllow review repairs
target.body:
## Summary
- Extends Policy doctor review-required repair previews to `tools.alsoAllow` drift.
- Adds skipped, non-mutating previews for `policy/tools-also-allow-missing` and `policy/tools-also-allow-unexpected` on global and agent-scoped config paths.
- Documents the Policy-owned `tools.alsoAllow` preview behavior in `docs/cli/policy.md` without changing generic Doctor docs.

## Real behavior proof
Behavior or issue addressed:
`doctor --fix` can now surface review-required preview guidance for `tools.alsoAllow` missing/unexpected policy findings without mutating config or counting the checks as repaired.

Real environment tested:
Windows PowerShell. The implementation was validated in a hydrated OpenClaw checkout, then applied to clean push checkout `C:\src\openclaw-policy-also-allow-push` at head `c0525e8`, stacked after #101336 head `e065bd2`.

Exact steps or command run after this patch:
1. `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts --reporter=dot`
2. `node scripts/check-docs-mdx.mjs docs/cli/policy.md docs/cli/doctor.md`
3. `pnpm docs:map:check`
4. `git diff --check`
5. `rg -n "<<<<<<<|=======|>>>>>>>" docs/cli/policy.md extensions/policy/src/doctor/review-required-repairs.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/scopes/tools.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts`

Evidence after fix:
Focused policy doctor Vitest passed: 302 tests. Docs MDX passed for `docs/cli/policy.md` and `docs/cli/doctor.md`. `pnpm docs:map:check` passed and reported the docs map is up to date. Whitespace check passed. Conflict marker search returned no matches. The final slice diff is four files and 192 insertions: review-required repair helper, tools scope repair wiring, focused registered-check tests, and Policy docs.

Observed result after fix:
Missing `alsoAllow` findings preview `would-append-after-review` config effects for the exact global or agent-scoped `tools.alsoAllow` entry. Unexpected `alsoAllow` findings preview `would-remove-after-review` config effects. The repair result stays `status: skipped`, leaves config unchanged, and leaves findings present for operator review.

What was not tested:
No packaged CLI invocation was run. The clean push checkout was intentionally kept without `node_modules` after validation because hydrating this Windows repo can create tracked workspace-link side effects under nested `node_modules` fixtures.

## Stack
- Stacked after #101336 (`policy: preview review-required tool repairs`).
- Base stack: #99776 -> #101336 -> this PR.
